cases.name: purge migrates the older layouts and keeps one work file: aside batch dropped, done batch cycles kept, stopped batch kept, lots/ reports moved without overwriting batches/, 3 runs kept
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/rw/run; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py purge $R 2026-10-13-1200 >/dev/null && echo "$(ls -A $R | tr '\n' ' ')|$(ls $R/batches | tr '\n' ' ')|$(head -1 $R/batches/F8.md)|$(python3 -c 'import json,sys,collections; c=collections.Counter(); [c.update([(r["kind"]+" "+r.get("batch",r.get("run","")))]) for r in map(json.loads, open(sys.argv[1]))]; print(" ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k,v in sorted(c.items())))' $R/.work.jsonl)"

expect.stdout: .work.jsonl 2026-10-13-0826 2026-10-13-0835 batches |F1.md F8.md |## STATUS — DONE|cycle F6=1 cycle F8=1

cases.name: purge of a run folder holding nothing removes the empty work file
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/rw-empty-{{SID}}/run; mkdir -p $R && printf '' > $R/.work.jsonl && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py purge $R && ls -A $R | wc -l | tr -d ' '

cases.name: append gives a cycle without slug the slug of its behaviour, journal appends then reads a run's lines, drop removes by batch and kind
cases.cmd: W={{FIX}}/rw-append-{{SID}}.jsonl; rm -f $W; echo '{"kind": "cycle", "batch": "F1", "state": {"behaviour": "Une création refusée"}}' | python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py append $W && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py journal $W S1 start of S1 && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py journal $W S1 && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py drop $W --batch F1 --kind cycle && grep -c une-creation-refusee $W

expect.stdout:
appended cycle F1
start of S1
dropped 1 line(s)
0

cases.name: append refuses a line of an unknown kind
tmp hands out the same folder of the system temp directory on every call, never under the run folder
cases.cmd: a=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py tmp F1) && b=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py tmp F1) && [ "$a" = "$b" ] && [ -d "$a" ] && case "$a" in */cctoolkit-run/*/F1) echo same;; esac

cases.name: rm-tmp removes the named tmp folders and nothing else
cases.cmd: a=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py tmp rmt-a-{{SID}}) && b=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py tmp rmt-b-{{SID}}) && c=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py tmp rmt-c-{{SID}}) && touch $a/f && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py rm-tmp rmt-a-{{SID}} rmt-b-{{SID}} && [ ! -e $a ] && [ ! -e $b ] && [ -d $c ] && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py rm-tmp rmt-c-{{SID}} && echo removed

cases.name: rm-tmp refuses a name escaping the tmp root, or no name
cases.cmd: python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py rm-tmp ../x 2>/dev/null; e1=$?; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py rm-tmp a/b 2>/dev/null; e2=$?; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py rm-tmp 2>/dev/null; echo "$e1 $e2 $?"

cases.name: purge: audit-round and attempt lines live while their batch is open only, breaker lines with their run's journal
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/rw-kinds-{{SID}}/run; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/batches && W=$R/.work.jsonl && for l in '{"kind":"audit-round","batch":"F1","round":1,"open":2,"files":[]}' '{"kind":"attempt","batch":"F1","step":"GREEN x","n":1,"reason":"r"}' '{"kind":"audit-round","batch":"F2","round":1,"open":1,"files":[]}' '{"kind":"cycle","batch":"F2","slug":"s","state":{}}' '{"kind":"breaker","run":"2026-10-15-1000","asides":["F3"],"decision":"continue","cause":""}' '{"kind":"breaker","run":"2026-10-01-1000","asides":[],"decision":"continue","cause":""}'; do printf '%s' "$l" | python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py append $W >/dev/null; done && printf '## STATUS — DONE\n' > $R/batches/F2.md && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-work.py purge $R 2026-10-15-1000 >/dev/null && jq -r '[.kind, (.batch // .run)] | join(":")' $W | tr '\n' ' '
